units.source_text: 她的坟墓坐落在小径的深处，只不过是一座小石堆，夹在一株巨大的枫树和一株老朽的梅树之间。

en.t: Her grave lay deep along the path, nothing more than a small mound of stones, wedged between a huge maple tree and an old, decaying plum tree.

units.source_text: 我和柏木为了表示对死者的钦佩，献上了短小的经文。

en.t: Kashiwagi and I offered a short sutra to show our reverence for the dead.
